name: Allstar
what_it_is: Clip capture tool for competitive games that records highlights and hosts them in Allstar Studio.
platforms: Desktop app, plus iOS and Android apps
pricing: Described as free clip capture; the help center lists subscriptions and product tiers without prices on the pages opened.
notable: Game list on the homepage: Counter-Strike 2, League of Legends, Fortnite and Dota 2

facts.fact: The homepage describes Allstar as free, fast and easy clip capture with zero FPS drop for Counter-Strike 2, League of Legends, Fortnite and Dota 2.
The help center lists Allstar Studio, Montages, Clip Feed and AllstarBot as product areas, and says Allstar is available as an iOS and Android app.
The help center has a Billing and Subscriptions section about Allstar subscriptions and product tiers, and its footer reads Allstar Gaming, Inc.
